pages.title: Vicuña
pages.text: The vicuña ($(o)Vicugna vicugna$()) is a wild camelid native to the high Andes of South America, living in alpine grasslands at elevations above 3,000 metres.$(br2)It is the smallest living camelid and the wild ancestor of the alpaca.$(br2)Its wool is extremely fine and warm. Once hunted close to extinction for it, the vicuña has recovered under protection and is the national animal of Peru.
